description: The motherboard ASUS PRIME Z890-P WIFI is designed for construcciones of high performance.. The motherboards ASUS of the Prime series are designed for expertos for unleash the full potential of the latest processors Intel ® Core ™ Ultra (Series 2). The motherboard PRIME Z890-P WIFI, that features a design of power robust, soluciones of cooling completas and tuning options intelligent, provides to the users and to the DIY PC builders a series of optimizaciones of performance through features intuitive of software and firmware. Is designed for ser a PC preparado for the IA advanced, ofreciendo the power and the connectivity necesarias for the demanding aplicaciones of IA. The Soluciones AI of ASUS include AI Advisor as your experto technical in performance of the PC, AI Networking II for the optimization of the bandwidth in real time and AI Cooling II for the control automatizado of the temperatura. A power stable is crucial for maximizar the performance of the processors Intel ® Core ™ Ultra (Series 2). The PRIME Z890-P WIFI is designed for satisfacer the needs of the CPU of high number of cores. Features 14(80A) + 1(80A) + 2(80A) + 1(80A) power stages that integran MOSFETs and drivers of lado high and low in paquetes with capacidad of up to 80 amperios each uno. This configuration ensures a power delivery, an efficiency, a stability and a performance optimal for the processors Intel ® actuales and futuros. ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III) is a function of firmware advanced that lets to the users conseguir a performance of memory without precedentes with the memory CUDIMM next-generation. Through a proceso of ajuste integral in two fases, the AEMP III optimizes primero the controlador of clock and later the frequency of the memory. This da as resultado the best equilibrio between performance and stability, incluso a velocidades of cutting edge of DDR5-7600 or superiores. 4 DIMM Fit is a function of the BIOS exclusiva of ASUS that analiza with precision the modules of memory individuales for optimizar the performance and detectar posibles problemas. This offers the maximum eficacia, compatibility and stability of the system.
